map.仅作起点，仍需摸盆土（竹签插入拔出不湿即浇）；通风、光照、盆土差异大，按实际微调: Treat it as a starting point; still check the soil (push a chopstick in and pull it out, and water when it comes out dry). Ventilation, light and soil vary a lot, so fine-tune against reality.
map.为什么夏季反而要勤浇？: Why do I need to water more often in summer?
map.高温蒸发快、盆土易干，但正午忌浇冷水；早晚浇、叶面喷水增湿更安全。: Evaporation is fast in high temperatures and the soil dries out easily, but never pour cold water at midday; watering in the morning and evening and misting the leaves is safer.
